name: Katsura Fuuta
source:
Murota Academy, cooking course 1st year student.
He was born and raised on an isolated rural island, so he's pretty laid back, but sometimes he gets homesick.
When he was confused about the trains on the day of the academy's entrance examination he was saved by [url=/c42195]Kaname[/url] and they became acquaintances.
